rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded/full blastocyst with thinned zona, visible ICM, cohesive TE, and minimal fragmentation, which is broadly consistent with a 3AA embryo; minor hedging and some speculative comments limit precision.
Integrates age, AMH, BMI, PCOS diagnosis, prior ectopic, sperm parameters, endometrial thickness, and lifestyle factors well, and connects them appropriately to prognosis and transfer planning.

Overall logic is clear and conclusions generally follow from the data, especially around favorable prognosis and SET; minor inconsistencies include discussion of euploidy rates and some speculative AMH/PCOS interpretation.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF best practice: SET for a young patient with a good-quality blastocyst, luteal support, no routine adjuncts, and selective rather than routine PGT-A; slight overreach in ancillary suggestions prevents a perfect score.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support, early ectopic surveillance, and uterine/tubal evaluation if unsuccessful; useful though not highly protocol-specific.
